free_tier.stated: Reported, and the two listings disagree: '25 NZBs monthly, 10 API calls monthly' in one, '50 NZBs/day, 25 API, No BluRay/4K Movie sections' in the other. The site's own pages were walled and not read.
free_tier.notes: unverified: the allowance is third-party and conflicting; the pricing page was behind a bot challenge.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file, never the payload

retention.stated: A third-party listing claims 'Exceeds 500 days, 25+ newsgroups indexed'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file.

interface_detail: Newznab-based indexer per the listings; the API path was not read.
tooling: Listings call it Newznab with an API counter on the free tier, so Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 would add it with URL plus key; the key sits behind a sign-up.
chaining: A paid Supporter step at USD 12 to 15 per year is the reported way past a free allowance of a few dozen calls.

limits.value: reported: 25 NZBs and 10 API calls monthly (one listing) or 50 NZBs and 25 API per day (another)

binding_note: The free counters are the only numeric limit named, and they are third-party and conflicting.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the sign-up form was behind a bot challenge. A listing names the registration as open and says payment accepts cards, Bitcoin and gift cards.

reliability_note: Every direct request on the read date was answered with HTTP 403 and a redirect to the login page; a listing reports 98% uptime.
confidence_note: Every value is third-party; the site answered a bot challenge (HTTP 403) to a direct request.

evidence.quote: Generous free tier: 25 NZBs monthly, 10 API calls monthly.

third-party: paid tiers are Supporter USD 12 per year and VIP USD 25 per year
